title: Markdown Report Example Data
description: Schema for markdown-report example input data used to render company KPIs, regional activity, and risk notes.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema identifier for the data document itself.

company.description: Company metadata displayed in the report header.

name.description: Display name of the company the report summarizes.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the report data was generated.

kpi.description: Top-level KPI metrics shown in the report summary section. Consumers should enforce that active_users_30d is less than or equal to total_users and that conversion_rate remains between 0 and 1. Consumers must ensure active_users_30d <= total_users.

total_users.description: Total number of users in the measured population.

active_users_30d.description: Number of users active during the last 30 days.

conversion_rate.description: Conversion rate as a ratio between 0 and 1.

active_users_by_region.description: Breakdown of active users by region for regional report sections. Region names must be unique within this array.

name.description: Region name label used in report tables or bullet lists.

users.description: Active user count for the region.

risks.description: List of risk statements to include in the report's risk section.
